title: Conversion to a binary real decision tree
statement: Given a finite decision tree with sign-valued labels and sign-valued queries, indexed by a set of available coordinates among $\mathrm{Fin}(n)$, define a binary decision tree with real labels on the same available coordinates. Each leaf label is converted to its real sign value; each query is retained, with its zero child taken from the original child indexed by $1$ and its one child from the child indexed by $-1$.
hypotheses_covered: type of query outcomes is the sign set $\{\pm1\}$
type of leaf labels is the sign set $\{\pm1\}$
finite set of available coordinates contained in $\mathrm{Fin}(n)$
finite decision tree on that available-coordinate set
